title: Reserved published provider catalog snapshot format v1
description: Immutable publication manifest format, not an active catalog or publication API. Declared REVIEWED statuses and publication metadata remain unauthenticated until resolved against authoritative Core storage. JSON Schema checks shape only; Core format inspection checks canonical hashes, complete fact targeting and semantic consistency. Neither grants trust, approval or publication. Content and manifest digests are different from the existing proposal v1 base-draft digest.

previousSnapshot.description: Null declares an initial publication, not a trusted bootstrap. Non-null identifies the previous manifest; identity/label cannot be reused. Parent authenticity and lineage require future Core storage.

factEvidenceStatuses.description: Exactly one declared status per recorded catalog fact, no omitted or foreign targets. This sidecar is bound by the manifest hash; it is not the existing manual observation ledger and never promotes a draft by parsing alone.
